title: Leo/need Chapter1 Episode16 Tell Me Straight

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Nah, I've got my sports club, and Ichi's working after school, I think?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah. I have to go now or I'll be late.
See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I've got to go too.
You don't have any plans this evening?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I've got some minor business to attend to.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ooh, that has a cool grown-up ring to it! Anyway, I'm off to my club. See you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll take the printouts to the teacher.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-Sorry. I've got to take something to the teachers' room...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you going to keep evading me forever?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I heard about your classmate troubles.
You've been acting weird ever since.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You'll probably think I'm full of crap for saying this to you after I tried to cut ties with everyone earlier...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I'm going to say it anyway. Are you sure this is what you want?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki told you she's given up, but you're not dumb, so you must know that's not true.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't you care about Saki's feelings?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then what is it you want?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki wants what's best for you. She's forcing herself to abandon your friendship because she thinks that will make you happy. Who are you doing all this for?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're only thinking about protecting your own feelings.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're so scared someone will hurt you that you prefer to run away when things get difficult.

rows.Speaker: Ex-Classmate
rows.Line: You act chummy with just about anyone.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You don't know? Really? You made Saki cry, you realize that, don't you?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What? I...I don't want to make her sad! But...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't want to be bullied again!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Right. So it's clear, you don't give a damn about us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: One last thing. You probably see this without me pointing it out but...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're making it pretty obvious you think your current friends would turn on you given half a chance.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't know, maybe you're only concerned with looking out for number one.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I know Honami didn't come to us for help because she didn't want us to worry.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why can I only say such hurtful things to her?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho? I wasn't expecting to run into you at this time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. What are you up to?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I went to the studio on my own. I wanted to clear my head get some solo practice in.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But...I messed up. I said some really mean things to her.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why am I so useless with things like this? I'm really hating myself right now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I can't even articulate why I went to talk to her in the first place. I'm such an idiot.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You know, that's something I really admire about you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, your determination. Once you make up your mind about something, you act. I think that's impressive.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I could never be like that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are you talking about? Whenever I was getting into an argument with someone, you'd always stop me right away.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You'd interrupt to stop me fighting even when you had no idea what it was about. Sometimes everyone'd be confused as to why you were getting involved at all.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's okay. Thanks to you, most arguments got ended pretty quickly.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It seems like nowadays you tend to overthink everything, and that's stopping you from being more decisive.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's how it looks to me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I should be thanking you. I feel better after talking with you.
